objective: Evaluate the tool-bearing omp_toolbelt Rig against the image-only omp_extension baseline on real dataset gold: the new transcribe/ancientdoc-development/v1 suite covering all 28 AncientDoc development pages with per-volume scope flags as protected slices.
hypothesis: On printed pages where the detector is strong, host-staged geometry evidence and deterministic count verification lower character error versus the image-only baseline of the same model, keep repetition at zero, and hold invented characters within the scope-adjusted allowance on both protected scope slices.

suite.verified: bench verify: cases=28 objects=63 candidates=37 judges=1 reports=49
suite.gold_provenance: ByteDance/AncientDoc dataset transcriptions at revision 149c447ebff66792cee28e02000682820858f17b, used as-is and marked development_non_qualifying; per-volume scope flags (9 scope_primary, 5 scope_full) ride in strata and both flags are protected slices
suite.invented_allowance_note: 0.5 instead of the print-perfect 0.15 because scope_primary volumes exclude commentary the reader legitimately transcribes; the paired comparison is the decision signal, the allowance only guards catastrophe.

candidates.identity_note: The exact immutable candidates already evaluated on the f004r case; nothing re-rendered.

execution.policy: Run the four declared smoke cases first; start the full 28-case run only if every smoke session finishes with a sealed submission, no repetition hard-limit violation, and observed smoke spend at or below 4 USD.

gates.smoke_budget: smoke spend at or below 4 USD
gates.full_quality: challenger mean character_error_rate at or below the baseline's on the same run
gates.full_hard_limits: all four suite limits pass on the challenger
gates.budget_stop: bench run --max-cost aborts dispatch at the ceiling

budget.paid_gpu: none; RF-DETR runs on the local workstation GPU

allowed_changes: library/evaluations/runs (run records produced by bench run)
non_goals: Do not touch AncientDoc qualification-reserve books.
Do not run bench propose or promote.
Do not modify the exodia campaign loop or partition.
next_permitted_action: Run the four-case smoke under the smoke budget, evaluate the smoke gates, then run the full 28 cases only if every gate passes.
